Mulberry Crush
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 9:53pm

Ingredients




1 env Mulberry Flavored Koolaid
1 cup Sugar
4 cups Cold Water
6 ounces Can Frozen Lemonade Concentrate, thawed
1 pkt (10 Oz) Frozen Mulberries, thawed
cup Lemon-Lime Soda
Mulberry Sherbet

Preparation

1 Combine koolaid powder and sugar. Add water; stir until koolaid and sugar are dissolved. Stir in lemonade concentrate and Mulberries. Chill. Jest before serving, gently stir in lemon-lime soda. Serve over ice cubes. Top with Mulberry sherbet.
